cryptohome: Remove NVRAM access path in finalize_from_cmdline This drops the code path that attempts to load the system key from NVRAM in mount-encrypted's commandline-trigged finalization code. There isn't any known scenario where this code would have worked, because mount-encrypted wouldn't have been able to access the TPM anyways as /dev/tpm0 is claimed by tcsd or trunksd. While at it, make sure the finalize_from_cmdline code path can't access the TPM by running it with a custom SystemKeyLoader implementation that just knows the passed-in system key and doesn't actually attempt to access the TPM. This also fixes the timeout due to TPM access failure, which wasn't correctly implemented (i.e. constructing a TPM object would attempt to open the TPM). BUG=None TEST=Builds and passes tests. Change-Id: I7eb79aa841d68419171f3e0bb15c335be25cece5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1085050 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Remove migration in mount-encrypted This removes all logic that decides whether a previous unencrypted stateful file system is OK to be migrated. The code that actually performs migration is left untouched since it is pending cleanup which I don't want to interfere with. Migration was originally implemented for the benefit of devices that got set up with an OS version that didn't support encrypted stateful. This was only the case during the very early days shortly after public launch of Chrome OS, but all devices that might have been set up with unencrypted stateful are no longer support anyways. BUG=None TEST=Compiles and passes tests. Change-Id: Icfd5b23ae0a09ae0d3e622713215ee22d3a34f77 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1085051 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Tested-by: Mattias Nissler <mnissler@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>

Revert "shill: Pass RPC identifiers for l2tpipsec_vpn on command line" This reverts commit 09c1ef83b3b862202536d1a9142a0f613e176c38. Reason for revert: Breaks parts of shill that spawn pppd directly through ExternalTask. We should instead be setting the command line vars here https://cs.corp.google.com/chromeos_public/src/aosp/system/connectivity/shill/vpn/l2tp_ipsec_driver.cc?rcl=85da00b79a9a12190cc0edf5a5f72aff05f050ae&l=237 for the specific case of spawning l2tpipsec_vpn through ExternalTask.
